title: HO-Chennai upstream MPLS label stack corruption
root_cause: MPLS L3VPN label stack corruption on HO-Chennai eth1 facing ZO. LDP session flapped, labels re-advertised, but stale LFIB entries persisted causing packet forwarding delays.
resolution: Cleared LDP session (vtysh clear mpls ldp neighbor *). Labels re-converged in 23 seconds. Verified end-to-end CBS latency back to baseline.
